purpose: Teach: 西郷/母性/強まる/デリケート/青く/突っ込む/打ち込む/兼ね備え

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、明治維新の、本気で、絶対、西郷、絶対、隆盛、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, your paper on Saigō Takamori and the Meiji Restoration was genuinely impressive. I was really moved by the depth of your thinking.
lines.style: Warm, measured opening. Leans forward slightly. Clear admiration without exaggeration. Steady eye contact. The tone of a teacher who means what she says.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古代の、本気で、絶対、母性、絶対、観、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really wanted to explore the maternal perspective in ancient thought, and I'm grateful you saw that effort.
lines.style: Sincere and a little relieved. Speaks carefully, choosing words. Modest but not dismissive. The quiet gratitude of someone who's worked hard and been truly seen.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国際情勢が、本気で、絶対、強まる、絶対、緊張、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: The way you connected international tensions to historical context—that showed real intellectual breadth. You weren't just documenting; you were thinking.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slower pace. Reflective, as if working through the observation aloud. Genuine interest in the student's mind, not just the paper.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。古典芸能の、本気で、絶対、デリケート、絶対、な表現、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to be careful with how I treated those delicate cultural expressions. I wanted to honor them, not just cite them.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Leans in slightly. Protective almost—defending the choices made in the research. Still respectful to the teacher, but owning the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 夜空が、本気で、絶対、青く、絶対、染まる、絶対、瞬間、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: That moment you wrote about—the night sky turning blue—that was the kind of poetic detail that actually deepened the argument. Most students miss that entirely.
lines.style: Slightly lifted tone, like noticing something beautiful in real time. Warm smile underneath the words. Unhurried, genuine delight in the student's sophistication.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。歴史上の、本気で、絶対、市場に、絶対、突っ込む、絶対、決断、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to show how historical actors made bold choices in the marketplace—how decisiveness was both personal and political.
lines.style: Controlled energy. Speaking with quiet conviction. Not defensive, but articulate about intention. Ownership of the argument without apology.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統技能に、本気で、絶対、打ち込む、絶対、職人の姿、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the section on artisans and traditional craft—how you showed their dedication through both action and reflection—that was sophisticated work.
lines.style: Slows down mid-sentence. Pause before 'reflection.' The tone of someone turning a page and realizing the depth that was there all along. Genuine admiration.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。複数の才を、本気で、絶対、兼ね備えた、絶対、人物像、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I was really drawn to figures who held multiple talents—people who refused to be boxed in. That felt important to explore.
lines.style: Confident but not cocky. Final statement of purpose. Calm, assured delivery. The conclusion of someone who's defended their own thinking and found it sound.
